title: Saving another 100TB of RAM
summary: Cloudflare's engineering team optimized memory usage in their HTTP proxy infrastructure, saving approximately 100TB of RAM by applying mathematical techniques to their Caddy-based stack. The optimization focuses on reducing memory overhead through clever data structure redesign and memory allocation strategies.
problem_solved: Massive RAM consumption in Cloudflare's globally distributed HTTP proxy infrastructure that was causing inefficient resource utilization at scale.
why_valuable: Saving 100TB of RAM translates to significant cloud infrastructure cost reduction, improved server density, and better performance for global edge network operations.
